usage: for households and families as residents (一户人家, 一百户居民).
example: 这栋楼住着二十户人家。
exampleEn: Twenty households live in this building.

usage: for doors and windows (一扇门, 一扇窗).
exampleEn: He pushed open a door.

usage: for flowers and branches (一枝花, 一枝梅花) — like 支 but for plants.
exampleEn: She is holding a flower in her hand.

usage: for buildings and houses (一栋楼, 一栋房子).
example: 学校新建了一栋教学楼。
exampleEn: The school built a new teaching building.

usage: a drop of liquid (一滴水, 一滴眼泪).
example: 瓶子里一滴水都没有了。
exampleEn: There is not a single drop of water left in the bottle.

usage: for small grains and pellets: rice, sand and pills (一粒米, 一粒药).
exampleEn: There are a few grains of rice on the floor.

usage: for ships and boats (一艘船, 一艘军舰).
exampleEn: A ship is docked at the harbor.

usage: for hats and caps (一顶帽子, 一顶帐篷).
example: 冬天出门要戴一顶帽子。
exampleEn: Wear a hat when you go out in winter.

usage: for plants — a more formal or literary word for 棵 (一株花).
exampleEn: A plum tree grows in the yard.

usage: for chapters of a book (第三章, 这本书有十章).
exampleEn: This book has twelve chapters in all.

usage: a string or bunch of items threaded or clustered together (一串葡萄, 一串钥匙).
exampleEn: He is holding a bunch of keys.

usage: a roll of something rolled up (一卷纸, 一卷胶带).
exampleEn: I bought a roll of tape.

usage: a plate of food (一盘菜, 一盘水果) and games of chess or go (一盘棋).
exampleEn: A plate of fruit sits on the table.

usage: a pot or kettle of (一壶茶, 一壶水).
exampleEn: The waiter brought a pot of tea.

usage: a jar or can of (一罐可乐, 一罐蜂蜜).
exampleEn: There is a can of cola in the fridge.

usage: liter (一升水, 两升牛奶).
exampleEn: I bought two liters of milk.

usage: cun, a traditional length unit of about 3.33 cm; still used for photo sizes (一寸照片).
example: 办护照要交两张两寸照片。
exampleEn: You need to submit two two-inch photos for a passport.

usage: chi, a traditional length unit of about 33 cm (一尺布).
exampleEn: He bought two chi of cloth.

usage: square meter — used for the area of homes and land (一百平方米).
example: 我家房子有一百平方米。
exampleEn: My home is one hundred square meters.

usage: out of ten, tenths (八成 = 80 percent, 三成 = 30 percent).
example: 他有八成把握通过考试。
exampleEn: He is eighty percent sure he will pass the exam.

usage: milliliter (五百毫升).
exampleEn: This bottle of water holds 500 milliliters.

usage: millimeter (五毫米).
exampleEn: This piece of glass is five millimeters thick.

usage: week — the formal word for 星期 (一周 = one week).
exampleEn: A week has seven days.

usage: for games and matches (一局棋, 一局比赛, 三局两胜).
example: 我们下了一局棋，他赢了。
exampleEn: We played a game of chess and he won.

usage: an instance of speaking or effort (一番话 = a speech, 费了一番功夫 = put in real effort).
example: 老师的一番话让我很感动。
exampleEn: The teacher's words moved me deeply.

usage: for rounds of competitions, talks or interviews (第一轮比赛, 第二轮面试).
exampleEn: The interview process has three rounds in total.

usage: kind, type — used when counting different sorts together (三样菜, 一样东西).
exampleEn: Several different dishes are set out on the table.

usage: for models and styles of products (这款手机, 新款).
exampleEn: This model of phone works really well.

usage: a double handful — something held in two cupped hands (一捧水, 一捧沙); 捧花 = a bouquet held in both hands.
example: 小溪很清，他弯下腰捧了一捧水喝。
exampleEn: The stream was so clear that he cupped a double handful of water and drank.

usage: a thin sliver or ray of something abstract such as hope, life or light (一线希望, 一线生机); mostly used with 一.
example: 哪怕只有一线希望，我们也不会放弃。
exampleEn: Even if there is only a sliver of hope, we will not give up.
